feed.title: The petition to restore middle school sports — Lunenburg Budget Project
feed.subtitle: Are the cut middle school sports and their transportation restored, and paid from what?

entry.title: The petition to restore middle school sports: Finance Committee, 2026-10-22
entry.summary: Article 2 FY27 omnibus amendment. Unspent state aid and wrap funds proposed for a part-time teen librarian, two account clerks, MUNIS training, and finance committee reserve.

entry.title: Now following: The petition to restore middle school sports
entry.summary: Are the cut middle school sports and their transportation restored, and paid from what?

entry.title: The petition to restore middle school sports: Town Meeting, 2026-09-03
entry.summary: Transfer from the Winter Recovery Assistance Program (WRAP) special revenue fund to supplement the FY27 Lunenburg public schools operating budget, for restored middle school sports and transportation (Article 3, Motion A) — passed

entry.title: The petition to restore middle school sports: Select Board, 2026-09-01
entry.summary: Establish a special revenue fund, seeded with $36,000 from the WRAP funds, for Article 3. — passed 5-0-0

entry.title: The petition to restore middle school sports: Finance Committee, 2026-08-27
entry.summary: Public and board discussion of specific sports funding figures for article 3 (ski team, girls lacrosse, middle school sports)

entry.title: The petition to restore middle school sports: School Committee, 2026-08-26
entry.summary: That the School Committee support the spirit of the citizen petition if the funding came from a new Town funding source rather than existing school operating funds, and use the funds for the purposes requested if appropriated at Town Meeting. — passed unanimously

entry.title: The petition to restore middle school sports: Select Board, 2026-08-18
entry.summary: No vote will be taken on the WRAP funds tonight; the board will wait to hear from the School Committee (Wednesday) and Finance Committee public hearing (Aug 27) before deciding, likely at the September 1 meeting.

entry.title: The petition to restore middle school sports: Finance Committee, 2026-08-13
entry.summary: Chair asked the school committee to meet (tentatively August 26) before the August 27 public hearing to take up and discuss the citizens petition article.

entry.title: The petition to restore middle school sports: Select Board, 2026-08-10
entry.summary: Article 2 - citizens' petition to supplement FY27 school operating budget. A citizens' petition article asks the town to raise and appropriate or transfer from available funds a sum of money to supplement the school department's FY27 operating budget; no dollar figure was stated in this article as read.

entry.title: The petition to restore middle school sports: Select Board, 2026-08-04
entry.summary: September 3rd special town meeting warrant articles. Draft warrant currently lists the school committee's article (with a dollar amount) as article one and a citizens petition (no dollar amount stated) as article two.

entry.title: The petition to restore middle school sports: School Committee, 2026-07-29
entry.summary: Committee decided to submit its own school-committee warrant article for the additional state aid, rather than relying solely on Mandy Gilman's citizen petition, so the request could go through school committee process and be adjustable.

entry.title: The petition to restore middle school sports: Select Board, 2026-07-27
entry.summary: Call a special town meeting for Thursday, September 3, 2026 at 7:00 p.m. at the Lunenburg Middle High School Auditorium, per the citizens' petition, and open the warrant July 28, 2026 with it closing 5:00 p.m. Friday, August 7, 2026. — passed unanimously

entry.title: The petition to restore middle school sports: Select Board, 2026-07-21
entry.summary: School committee's request for a warrant article on additional FY27 state aid: state/town budget timeline, July 8 and July 15 school committee meetings, spending plan changes, citizens' petition for special town meeting
